sections.Profile:
"Hit Parade," released by Marvel Manufacturing Company in July 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine with a music and nightlife theme. The playfield features four flippers, ten passive bumpers, four kick-out holes, and two rollover buttons.

- Manufacturer: Marvel Manufacturing Company
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Good Times, Singing, Wood Rail, Dancing, Nightlife, Original Theme, Music
